purpose: Prioritize exact source binding for the first national baseline and Rose Bud community twin. This is a research/data queue, not a permission to build simulator UI.
binding_definition: A variable is bound only when its statistical definition, owner, exact source series/table/API path, geography, cadence, revision behavior, transformations, and missing-data rules are documented.

priority_0_national_fiscal_spine.reason: separates policy imbalance from inherited interest cost

priority_0_national_fiscal_spine.owner: CBO for baseline projection; Treasury/OMB for actuals

priority_0_national_fiscal_spine.initial_source: Treasury FiscalData Debt to the Penny

priority_0_national_fiscal_spine.owner: derived from compatible debt and GDP definitions; CBO baseline reference

priority_0_national_fiscal_spine.initial_source: BEA National Income and Product Accounts
Treasury yield/auction series and Federal Reserve market series

priority_2_rose_bud_twin: Rose Bud place population and age structure
Rose Bud/functional-region households and family structure
school district and school enrollment crosswalk
housing stock, vacancy, tenure, values and rents
health-access geography and CDC PLACES-compatible measures
transport travel time to regional jobs/services
farm/land availability and price research slot
priority_3_causal_parameter_research: local job availability to household retention
housing supply response to population demand
preventive health investment to long-run public cost
grid investment to electricity price/reliability/productive capacity
local ownership to local income/wealth retention
farm succession support to farm survival
child investment to long-run earnings/public cost
AI automation to task productivity/displacement by occupation
execution_rules: Bind Priority 0 before any national fiscal simulator work.
Do not begin Rose Bud scenario parameterization until the twin geography is explicitly defined.
Do not use county values as Rose Bud values without a geography-mismatch flag and visible disclosure.
Separate observed baseline source binding from causal parameter research.
Exact API/series binding belongs in the next slice, not this inventory pass.
Keep missing values null rather than inventing substitutes.
